podcast.body: The "Magnum Opus" of *Remain in Light*, this "cacophonous song" blended the band's interpretations of funk and Afrobeat with David Byrne's "elliptical lyrics," delivered with the "fiery cadence of a preacher." Lyrically, it explored the "mundanity and the mystery of the material world." Although initially "too advanced for the pop charts" and bubbling under the Hot 100 at number 103 in 1981, it has since become one of Talking Heads' most iconic and heavily streamed singles. "He called it once in a lifetime."
